an_ai_powered_self_discovery_platform: An AI-powered space for self-discovery, aesthetic identity, and creative expression.
hero_supporting: Explore who you are through visual experiences, cinema, fashion, and personal reflection. Discover the stories, images, and ideas that shape your sense of self.
brand_expression: Explore Yourself · Discover Aesthetics · Create Meaning
english_first_web_app_opens_in: English-first Web App — opens in any modern browser, no install. A tool for self-exploration and entertainment, not a psychological assessment or diagnosis.
placeholder_final_imagery_not_yet_produc: Placeholder — final imagery not yet produced
the_first_release_focuses_on_aesthetic: The first release focuses on Aesthetic Identity alone, so its image bank, visual coding and scoring can be validated before anything else is built on top of them. The other four matrices stay visible in Explore — honestly labelled as coming soon, with nothing behind them yet.
16_forced_choice_image_pairs_across: 16 forced-choice image pairs across 8 aesthetic dimensions and 32 coded indicators — from Minimalism to Extravagance.
four_further_matrices_are_fully_specifie: Four further matrices are fully specified in the product foundation and question-bank architecture, and will open one at a time as each is validated.
from_a_choice_to_a_portrait: From a choice to a portrait, in four steps
start_with_aesthetic_identity_the_only: Start with Aesthetic Identity — the only matrix available as a preview in this release.
sixteen_image_pairs_pick_the_one: Sixteen image pairs. Pick the one you are drawn to — no neutral option, no skipping.
scores_come_from_documented_reproducible: Scores come from documented, reproducible rules. AI never assigns or invents a score.
ai_reads_the_scored_profile_draws: Once scoring is live, AI will read the scored profile, draw connections between dimensions, and suggest where to explore next.
what_you_see_while_answering_is: What you see while answering is a short display ID. Behind it, the question bank keeps a permanent internal ID that ties the question to its matrix, its dimension and its scoring record.
question_bank_scoring_maps_version_histo: Question bank, scoring maps, version history
the_two_coded_indicators_an_image: The two coded indicators an image pair contrasts
how_the_numbering_works_in_full: How the numbering works, in full
each_matrix_explores_a_different_layer: Each matrix explores a different layer of who you are. Only Aesthetic Identity is open in this release; the rest are specified, scheduled, and locked until they are ready — no previews pretending to be results.
your_visual_preferences_across_fashion_f: Your visual preferences across fashion, film, art, architecture and design — measured through image choices, not words.
behavioural_tendencies_communication_sty: Behavioural tendencies, communication style, decision habits and social preferences, explored through written questions.
how_you_relate_to_cities_living: How you relate to cities, living spaces, travel, spending and the rhythm of everyday life.
the_fit_between_your_living_conditions: The fit between your living conditions and care capacity, and what different pets actually need.
interests_developing_skills_preferred_wo: Interests, developing skills, preferred working environments and possible career themes.
html.why_only_one_is_open_each: Why only one is open. Each matrix needs its own validated question bank and scoring rules before it can say anything trustworthy. Aesthetic goes first because visual preference is the most shareable, most immediate entry point — and because its framework (8 dimensions, 32 indicators, a visual coding manual) is the furthest along.
your_visual_preferences_across_fashion_f: Your visual preferences across fashion, film, art, architecture and visual culture — discovered through images, not words. You are shown two images and choose the one you are drawn to. Sixteen choices build a profile across eight dimensions.
html.each_question_contrasts_two_indicat: Each question contrasts two indicators from different dimensions — a cross-dimension pairing. That is deliberate: it forces a real preference trade-off instead of asking the same dimension twice.
minimalism_clean_silhouettes_few_element: Minimalism. Clean silhouettes, few elements, geometric clarity.
extravagance_layered_ornament_rich_detai: Extravagance. Layered ornament, rich detail, decoration built up in levels.
the_32_original_question_images_have: The 32 original question images have not been produced yet, so this pair is shown with placeholder blocks. Every final image will be coded under the Visual Coding Manual — one primary indicator, up to three secondary indicators, written visual evidence, and a confidence rating; low-confidence images never enter the bank.
html.confirmed_pairings_aes_q001_m01_e01: Confirmed pairings: AES-Q001 = M01 × E01, AES-Q002 = M02 × E02, AES-Q003 = M03 × E03, AES-Q004 = M04 × E04 and AES-Q005 = H01 × V01 (Historical Continuity × Historical References). Pairings for Q006–Q016 are to be determined.
from_the_secondary_indicators_framework_: From the Secondary Indicators Framework V1.0. Open a dimension to see its four observable indicators — the visual evidence coders look for in every image.
a_preference_for_simplified_visual_langu: A preference for simplified visual language, clear structure, restrained decoration and ordered space.
clean_silhouettes_reduced_elements_geome: Clean silhouettes, reduced elements, geometric expression
negative_space_breathing_room_between_el: Negative space, breathing room between elements
low_ornament_simplified_detail_no_visual: Low ornament, simplified detail, no visual stacking
structural_balance_visual_order_harmonio: Structural balance, visual order, harmonious ratios
a_preference_for_historical_continuity_t: A preference for historical continuity, traditional forms and classic cultural symbols.
historic_styles_carried_forward_classic_: Historic styles carried forward, classic design language
traditional_patterns_cultural_symbols_hi: Traditional patterns, cultural symbols, historic ornament
regional_culture_traditional_craft_cultu: Regional culture, traditional craft, cultural identity
a_preference_for_softness_delicacy_emoti: A preference for softness, delicacy, emotional atmosphere and poetic expression.
flowing_curves_gentle_contours_nothing_r: Flowing curves, gentle contours, nothing rigid
mood_natural_imagery_a_sense_of: Mood, natural imagery, a sense of story
fine_detail_soft_ornament_delicate_textu: Fine detail, soft ornament, delicate texture
a_preference_for_body_awareness_sensory: A preference for body awareness, sensory experience, visual tension and confident expression.
body_contour_garments_that_follow_or: Body contour, garments that follow or emphasise structure
leather_silk_sheen_and_touch_in: Leather, silk, sheen and touch in contrast
strong_contrast_conflicting_lines_visual: Strong contrast, conflicting lines, visual impact
a_preference_for_experimentation_unconve: A preference for experimentation, unconventional structure, conceptual expression and breaking convention.
abstract_ideas_art_concepts_non_narrativ: Abstract ideas, art concepts, non-narrative expression
a_preference_for_visual_richness_layered: A preference for visual richness, layered decoration, vivid colour and dramatic effect.
a_commanding_focal_point_theatrical_effe: A commanding focal point, theatrical effect
saturated_colour_large_scale_pattern_bol: Saturated colour, large-scale pattern, bold combinations
rich_materials_lavish_surfaces_display_a: Rich materials, lavish surfaces, display and polish
a_preference_for_material_quality_making: A preference for material quality, making detail, precise structure and evident craft.
material_character_and_how_materials_wor: Material character and how materials work together
weaving_embroidery_carving_and_other_tec: Weaving, embroidery, carving and other techniques
a_preference_for_era_styles_cultural: A preference for era styles, cultural symbols, vintage visual language and cross-cultural expression.
elements_quoted_from_other_eras_period: Elements quoted from other eras, period atmosphere
regional_signs_folk_elements_cultural_pa: Regional signs, folk elements, cultural pattern
aged_texture_retro_colour_historic_media: Aged texture, retro colour, historic media feel
html.boundaries_the_coders_watch_minimal: Boundaries the coders watch. Minimalism is not Craftsmanship — visual simplicity says nothing about quality of making. Heritage is not Vintage — continuity of tradition is not a retro look. Romanticism is not Sensuality, and Extravagance is not Avant-garde: visual excess is not experimentation. These distinctions come straight from the framework, and every coded image has to respect them.
the_assessment_is_not_open_yet: The assessment is not open yet
this_page_fixes_the_layout_and: This page fixes the layout and format of the Aesthetic assessment so navigation and reading flow can be checked. The question images have not been produced and the interaction is not built — nothing here can be answered, and no result can come out of it.
progress_is_shown_as_a_question: Progress is shown as a question count only — never a percentage. Each question is a forced choice between two images: there is no neutral option and no skipping.
shown_aes_q001_internal_record_aes: Shown: AES-Q001 (internal record AES_MIN_001), pairing M01 Form Simplification × E01 Decorative Abundance. The frames above are placeholders — the original images are still to be made.
two_per_question_for_q001_q016: Two per question for Q001–Q016, produced to the visual coding manual — starting with an 8-image validation batch for Q001–Q004.
each_image_coded_by_two_reviewers: Each image coded by two reviewers independently, then reconciled. Low-confidence images are excluded.
q001_q005_pairings_are_confirmed_q006: Q001–Q005 pairings are confirmed; Q006–Q016 are decided as the bank is built, then frozen.
no_question_enters_the_live_assessment: No question enters the live assessment without a documented, validated scoring rule.
this_page_previews_the_shape_of: This page previews the shape of a result: how the eight dimensions will be presented once scoring is live.
html.layout_preview_only_the_values_belo: Layout preview only. The values below are illustrative placeholders that show the design — they are not a real result, nothing has been calculated, and the scoring engine is not connected in Foundation V1.2.
relative_strength_across_the_eight_dimen: Relative strength across the eight dimensions, strongest first in the full report.
what_a_finished_result_will_add: What a finished result will add
a_written_reading_of_your_scored: A written reading of your scored profile — patterns across dimensions, tensions worth noticing, questions to explore. The AI interprets scores; it never creates them.
every_score_traces_back_to_the: Every score traces back to the questions, indicator codes and scoring-rule version that produced it, so a result can always be re-derived and audited.
a_longer_paid_report_and_a: A longer paid report and a personal exploration archive are planned. All pricing is a hypothesis until it is validated with real users.
results_describe_preferences_not_fixed_i: Results describe preferences, not fixed identity. Preferences change, and a later result is allowed to disagree with an earlier one.
know_yourself_a_little_more_clearly: Know yourself, a little more clearly
the_ai_self_discovery_platform_exists: VIVINEA exists to help people discover what they love, understand what fits them, recognise their own patterns, and explore who they could become — through structured assessments, transparent scoring and AI interpretation, once they are live.
html.it_is_also_the_foundation_of: VIVINEA connects with the podcast BEFORE BECOMING, continuing to explore how we come to know ourselves, understand the world, and gradually become who we want to be.
it_is_deliberately_not_a_psychological: It is deliberately not a psychological test, not an MBTI-style typing tool and not a diagnosis. It is a structured mirror for self-exploration and entertainment, built to be honest about what it can and cannot claim.
english_first_interface_questions_and_re: English first — interface, questions and reports are written in English; other languages may follow without changing question IDs.
a_web_app_that_runs_in: A Web App that runs in the browser (including iPad Safari). Not a WeChat mini-program, and not yet a downloadable app.
aesthetic_identity_only_personality_iden: Aesthetic Identity only. Personality Identity is deferred to a later release; Lifestyle, Pet and Future remain in the long-term plan.
six_pages_for_navigation_and_layout: Six pages for navigation and layout verification. The assessment is a placeholder, the result is a layout preview, the images are placeholders, and there is no scoring, no AI report and no AI API connection.
individuality_explainability_adaptabilit: Individuality, explainability, adaptability, personalisation, privacy and non-judgment. Results are never permanent identity labels.
two_numbering_layers_because_a_question: Two numbering layers, because a question has two jobs: it appears in a sequence for the person answering, and it lives permanently in a database with a scoring record.
the_answering_order_shown_as_question: The answering order. Shown as “Question 1 of 16” — never as a percentage.
html.matrix_codes_aes_per_lif_pet: Matrix codes: AES, PER, LIF, PET, FUT. Dimension codes: MIN, HER, ROM, SEN, AVA, EXT, CRA, VIN for Aesthetic. The same scheme is reserved for later matrices, e.g. PER_SOC_001.
stored_on_every_aesthetic_record_alongsi: Stored on every Aesthetic record alongside the internal ID, with the two image IDs, because one question always spans two dimensions.
an_id_never_changes_once_published: An ID never changes once published, and is never reused.
editing_a_question_raises_its_version: Editing a question raises its version (e.g. 1.0 → 1.1); a substantial change creates a new ID.
old_results_stay_interpretable_through_t: Old results stay interpretable through the question, scoring-rule and content versions they were produced under.
ids_are_identical_across_all_language: IDs are identical across all language versions.
every_question_moves_through_draft_under: Every question moves through DRAFT → UNDER_REVIEW → PILOT → VALIDATED → PUBLISHED → ARCHIVED.
a_question_without_a_validated_scoring: A question without a validated scoring rule never enters the live assessment.
confirmed_pairings_q001_m01_e01_q002: Confirmed pairings: Q001 = M01 × E01, Q002 = M02 × E02, Q003 = M03 × E03, Q004 = M04 × E04, Q005 = H01 × V01. Pairings for Q006–Q016 are to be determined. Personality display IDs are reserved from PER-Q001 onwards. The total question count remains to be determined. Personality Identity is deferred.
foundation_v1_1_checked_on_ipad: Foundation V1.1 iPad Safari check pending: six pages, navigation, mobile and tablet layout to be verified.
eight_original_images_for_q001_q004: Eight original images for Q001–Q004, coded independently by two reviewers and reconciled.
the_remaining_24_images_all_16: The remaining 24 images, all 16 pairings frozen, then a pilot run with real users.
validated_scoring_real_results_and_ai: Validated scoring, real results, and AI interpretation layered on top — in that order.
framework_documents_behind_this_foundati: Framework documents behind this foundation: Product Foundation V1.0 · Assessment Framework V1.0 · Secondary Indicators V1.0 · Visual Coding Manual V1.0 · Question Bank Master Structure V1.0. Where those drafts still mention a mini-program, a Chinese-first launch or a two-matrix MVP, the decisions above supersede them.
